chunks: From him, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, who said: Several people from the companions of Ali ibn Abi Hamzah informed me that he asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the woman who is divorced in a manner contrary to the Sunnah.
Should the man marry her? He said: Bind them to that which they bound themselves to, and marry them, and there is no objection to that.

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: There is no objection / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man divorces his wife in a manner contrary to the Sunnah?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Rida (AS) regarding *ghayr al-sunnah* divorce, emphasizing the principle of *al-lazim li-ahlihi* (binding the parties to the consequences they incurred). The Imam instructs that since the husband initiated the irregular divorce, he must adhere to its specific legal implications—such as the waiting period (*iddah*) and the right of revocation or finality—and may subsequently marry her, validating the union despite the deviation from the ideal Sunnah procedure.
